description: Qualitative Figures Metadata for KITTI Split T (Task T16)
zero_touch_verification: Strictly read-only images and static predictions parquet (Decision D90)

figures.title: (a) Side View (theta = 8.6 deg, D19)
figures.description: Side aspect dilates bbox width to vehicle length (~4.5m), causing Zw to degenerate to 9.8m. Zh (18.4m) and Residual model (20.6m) accurately recover Z_gt (19.7m), covered by CQR [17.4, 23.6]m.

figures.title: (b) Near Physical 3D Bias (Pattern 111, D21/D92)
figures.description: Uncut vehicle at 7.9m exhibits systematic negative bias (-11.2%) in Zd (7.0m) due to surface vs center offset. Residual model eliminates bias (7.99m, AbsRel 0.96%), covered by CQR [6.8, 9.0]m.

figures.title: (c) Boundary Truncation & Adaptive CQR (D84/D91)
figures.description: Vehicle touching bottom edge (truncation 0.35) loses height and ground cues. CQR interval adaptively widens to [4.08, 7.07]m to conservatively contain Z_gt (6.37m) with z_hat (6.14m).

figures.title: (d) Successful Fallback Pattern 000 (D74)
figures.description: All 3 geometric cues invalid (cut on multiple borders). Direct model (e) estimates Ze = 7.75m; residual & CQR [7.22, 10.33]m reliably cover Z_gt = 7.91m (AbsRel 4.0%).

figures.title: (e) Top-1 Outlier Failure (Rank 1 Manifest)
figures.description: Extreme perspective distortion at image corner (x1=1.3, y2=373.3, truncated). Predicted 8.46m vs Z_gt 5.92m (AbsRel 42.92%). Demonstrates edge limitation documented in Section 6.

figures.title: (f) Sharp Success: 10-20m Range
figures.description: Representative success from frozen manifest (seed=42). Ground truth Z_gt = 11.19m, predicted z_hat = 11.19m (AbsRel 0.04%). Tight CQR interval [9.73, 12.87]m.

figures.title: (g) Sharp Success: 20-30m Range
figures.description: Representative success from frozen manifest. Ground truth Z_gt = 19.81m, predicted z_hat = 20.14m (AbsRel 1.69%). CQR interval [17.84, 23.40]m snugly bounds target.

figures.title: (h) Hard-Filtered Object Success
figures.description: Car under KITTI Hard difficulty criteria. Ground truth Z_gt = 20.19m, predicted z_hat = 19.67m (AbsRel 2.59%). CQR interval [17.26, 22.85]m covers object safely.
